acceptance: if harmful, prevention mode must be baseline and composite cost <= baseline cost * 1.05, with matching s2 OpenFlow action; otherwise actual route must match selected non-harmful mode
cost_formula: (latency_ms/20 + jitter_ms/5 + packet_loss_pct/1)/3; relative stage cost threshold 5%
demand: synthetic iperf3 TCP plus 5 ping probes per stage

metric_methods.jitter_ms: median absolute difference for adjacent successful RTT pairs; at least two pairs

topology: 4-switch diamond; S2-S3 shortcut physically down at baseline, enabled for candidate and prevention
